wiki-openai.recent: OpenAI released more than 350 mathematical findings in one day, after researchers in Cambridge rushed a 95-page paper out ahead of one of its proofs. Then the FBI arrested an engineer over a recording device hidden in a meeting room, and the FTC sent civil investigative demands asking whether its security incidents harmed Americans.

stocks:BAC.standing: The second-largest US bank by assets, listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Its share price tracks US interest rates, consumer credit and deposit flows across tens of millions of American accounts.
stocks:BAC.recent: The US Treasury imposed more than $1.21bn in penalties on Bank of America for anti-money-laundering and sanctions violations, the third-largest in the department's history, after the bank reported $5 billion in suspicious transactions late. The fine landed the day after the last reading, so it does not explain the slide before it.

stocks:SHEL.standing: One of the world's largest oil and gas companies, headquartered in London, and the biggest trader of liquefied natural gas. Its shares move with crude and gas prices and with the cash it returns to shareholders.
stocks:SHEL.recent: The one development about Shell's own business came after the latest close: it agreed to sell its Nigerian domestic gas business, which serves more than 130 customers, to Vaaris Energy. Nothing else in the fortnight concerned the company, so none of it accounts for the climb.

stocks:2222.SR.standing: Saudi Arabia's state oil company, the world's largest crude producer, listed on the Saudi Exchange in Riyadh since 2019. The state keeps almost all of it, so the small float trades on oil prices and the dividend.
stocks:2222.SR.recent: The Houthis claimed a strike on an oil facility near Riyadh, a missile set fire to an Aramco administrative building in Dhahran, and Aramco's CEO said replenishing crude and fuel supplies could take two years after almost 3 billion barrels were lost. Saudi Arabia also cut its oil prices to Asia. None of it accounts for the share's path.

stocks:COIN.standing: The largest US cryptocurrency exchange, listed on Nasdaq. Most of its revenue comes from trading fees and the interest on USDC stablecoin reserves, so its shares rise and fall with crypto prices and trading volume.

stocks:NVDA.standing: The American designer of the graphics processors that train and run most of the world's AI models. Data-centre chips earn most of its revenue, so its share price is read as a gauge of what the industry spends on AI.
stocks:NVDA.recent: SpaceX's big Nvidia buy was reported the week the share peaked. The day after the latest close, an IDC report put Nvidia at 34% of China's data-centre AI accelerator market in the first half of 2026 and Huawei at 28%. Nvidia's China shipments fell 44% to 678,000, as US export controls turned buyers toward China's own chips.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-us-pre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it rises and falls with his standing in the party.

stocks:ASML.standing: The Dutch company that builds the lithography machines chipmakers use to print circuits, and the only supplier of the extreme-ultraviolet tools that leading-edge chips need. Export rules decide who may buy them.
stocks:ASML.recent: China's share of ASML's sales jumped from 14% to 23%, with its equipment sales there up 109% despite a US push to curb exports. Earlier, BofA said an ASML chip technology move threatened Besi's shares. Neither accounts for the line: the China figures came out after the last close shown.

poly-will-benjamin-netanyahu-be-the-next.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Benjamin Netanyahu heads the government formed after Israel's next election. The premiership needs a 61-seat Knesset majority, so coalition arithmetic moves it as much as votes do.
poly-will-benjamin-netanyahu-be-the-next.recent: The fortnight's one story about Netanyahu himself was a lawsuit: Ronen Bar, the Shin Bet chief he tried to fire, is seeking 3 million shekels over the claim that Bar bears responsibility for 7 October, filed thirteen days before the 27 October election. Nothing reported accounts for the price.

stocks:T.standing: One of the three national US mobile networks, alongside Verizon and T-Mobile, and a large fibre broadband provider. A heavy debt load and a long-paid dividend make it a stock held mainly for income.
stocks:T.recent: The sharpest fall came when SpaceX struck a nationwide low-band spectrum deal for Starlink Mobile, putting a satellite operator into the phone business; Verizon fell with it. Days later AT&T agreed to sell AT&T Mexico and its 24.7 million subscribers to Grupo Televisa and Fintech Holdings for $2 billion in cash.

stocks:TLEVISACPO.MX.standing: Mexico's largest broadcaster, listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange, which also runs the izzi cable and broadband network and Sky satellite TV. Its share tracks Mexican household spending on pay TV and connectivity.
stocks:TLEVISACPO.MX.recent: Televisa agreed to pay $2 billion for AT&T's Mexican business and its 24.7 million subscribers, which turns a cable and broadband company into a mobile operator as well. The deal came at the end of the window, and nothing in the input explains the earlier swings in the share.

stocks:TEL.OL.standing: Norway's largest telecoms operator, majority-owned by the Norwegian state, running mobile networks across the Nordics and in Asia. Its dividend makes it a staple of Norwegian pension and income portfolios.
stocks:TEL.OL.recent: Plaintiffs in Oslo sued Telenor, saying it gave Myanmar's junta 1,253 phone numbers and then sold the network, with its call records and location data, to a junta-linked buyer. The suit was filed after the last close on the chart, so it does not explain the slide before it.

wiki-china.standing: The daily count of readers of Wikipedia's article on China, the world's second-largest economy and its largest exporter. It shows how often the country's affairs send a general audience to look it up.
wiki-china.recent: The fortnight's China news ran through Brussels and the border: the EU planned measures to cut imports of Chinese hybrid cars by half, and the New Yalu River Bridge opened to North Korea at Dandong, widening a trade lifeline despite UN sanctions China voted for. None of it lines up with the largest jump.

wiki-data-center.standing: A building packed with the servers, storage and network gear that run websites, cloud services and AI models. Its hunger for electricity and cooling now shapes grid planning and power deals.
wiki-data-center.recent: Data centres became targets in the war. Ukrainian drones knocked out 3 of Yandex's 6 Russian sites, including one in Kaluga, then hit Sberbank's data centre in Balakovo. Russian drones struck data centres in Kyiv and temporarily cut internet to 100,000 households. Separately, Google contracted 890 megawatts of new nuclear output.

stocks:FFH.TO.standing: A Toronto holding company that owns property and casualty insurers and reinsurers around the world and invests their premiums, run by Prem Watsa in a value style. It has built large stakes in Indian companies.
stocks:FFH.TO.recent: Fairfax won 60.72% of IDBI Bank for ₹52,878 crore, India's largest privatisation, which puts the insurer's balance sheet in control of an Indian lender. The award came after the chart's last close, so none of the line reflects it, and nothing in the input explains the earlier moves.

poly-no-hormuz-agreement-by-nov-2.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and the United States fail to reach a deal that reopens the Strait of Hormuz. It is what traders will pay for no agreement, a strait that carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil.
poly-no-hormuz-agreement-by-nov-2.recent: Iran said Washington's reply to its proposal to reopen the strait met only some of its seven conditions, and the talks gave way to attacks: six ships hit in one day, a container ship sunk by a mine, two Emirati cargo ships lost within 24 hours, and two more sinkings that led UKMTO to rate the threat severe.

poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-decembe.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Washington and Tehran reach an agreement over the Strait of Hormuz by year's end. About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes through the strait, so the price is a bet on Gulf shipping.
poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-decembe.recent: The slide came as the UK arrested a British-Iranian national over a suspected terror plot at RAF Fairford and the US pulled its bombers from the base, which Trump blamed on terror threats. The attacks at sea have since multiplied: six ships hit in a day, two Emirati cargo ships sunk, and US strike plans drafted around a 21,600-pound bomb.

stocks:PLTR.standing: Palantir Technologies, a US software company listed on Nasdaq, sells data-analysis platforms to defence ministries, intelligence agencies and large corporations. Government contracts make up a large share of its revenue.
stocks:PLTR.recent: France chose Chapsvision over another Palantir contract, as European governments question how much of their state data runs on the company's software. Palantir's Louis Mosley answered that Europe is 'missing the boat' on AI. Neither development explains the share's rise.

stocks:GFS.standing: A contract chipmaker that builds other companies' designs, specialising in older, cheaper process nodes used in cars, phones, radios and defence electronics. It is one of the few foundries headquartered in the US.
stocks:GFS.recent: Washington doubled its equity stake in GlobalFoundries to nearly 8% and will partner with it on a new fab at Malta, New York, a step from CHIPS Act grants to outright ownership. The deal came after this chart's last close, so it does not account for the rise shown here.

poly-will-apple-be-the-largest-company-i.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Apple is the world's most valuable listed company by market capitalisation at year's end. It prices a race among a handful of tech giants whose valuations swing on chips, AI spending and earnings.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the former Florida senator, wins the Republican presidential nomination for 2028. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.

stocks:RELIANCE.NS.standing: India's most valuable listed company, a Mumbai conglomerate that runs the Jamnagar refining complex alongside Jio telecoms and India's biggest retail chain. Its size makes it a swing stock for the whole Indian market.
stocks:RELIANCE.NS.recent: Reliance is listing Jio Platforms, its telecoms arm, in a share sale seeking up to ₹30,213 crore, India's largest offering. The Times of India reckoned the listing would carry Reliance Industries past Tata as the country's most valuable group, because a market price for Jio puts a public value on the stake Reliance keeps.

stocks:ACN.standing: One of the world's largest consulting and IT-services firms, incorporated in Ireland and listed in New York. Its shares track how much corporations spend on outsourcing, and lately on help adopting AI.
stocks:ACN.recent: The one story about Accenture's own business was a cost cut: staff who had spent up to $1,000 a month on Claude were capped at $29, a firm that sells AI transformation to clients now rationing it for its own workers. It landed at the end of the rise, which began in late September, and does not account for it.

stocks:NESN.SW.standing: The world's largest packaged-food company, based in Vevey, Switzerland, selling Nescafé, Maggi, Purina and infant formula almost everywhere. A heavyweight of the Swiss SMI, its share moves with coffee, cocoa and dairy costs.
stocks:NESN.SW.recent: India's food regulator, FSSAI, found a Nestlé dairy whitener sample unsafe and substandard, in a wider crackdown that also suspended a confectionery firm and recalled cumin; Nestle said the product was safe. The share's trough came the next day. Nothing reported since accounts for the recovery.

stocks:BA.L.standing: Britain's largest defence company, building warships, nuclear submarines, combat aircraft and munitions, with a large US arm. Its shares move on NATO governments' defence budgets and the export orders they approve.
stocks:BA.L.recent: A cyberattack on BAE Systems, working as a contractor for the US courts, halted all notices for US bankruptcy courts. The attack was reported in Washington after the slide had already happened, and nothing else in the input explains the price.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Democrats hold a Senate majority after the November 2026 US midterm elections. The Senate confirms judges and cabinet picks and ratifies treaties, so its majority decides what a president can pass.

poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if US forces invade Iran before 2027. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it separates a ground war from the air and sea strikes that stop short of one.
poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.recent: The fighting these bets turn on is at sea and in the air. Six ships were hit in Hormuz the day after a US jet disabled an Iran-linked tanker, two Emirati cargo ships sank within 24 hours, and US planners drafted strikes with a 21,600-pound bomb. None of it puts US ground troops inside Iran.

poly-oil-below-80-on-november-2-and-the-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays only if two things both happen: oil trades under $80 on Nov 2, and the Democrats win control of the US Senate in the midterms. It bets on cheap fuel and a Democratic Senate arriving together.
poly-oil-below-80-on-november-2-and-the-.recent: The fortnight's news about prediction markets was about who gets to regulate them, not about oil or the Senate race: 39 states and 145 tribal nations urged the Supreme Court to take up the question, and Kalshi's CEO said state-led oversight would push the markets out. None of it accounts for the price.

wiki-south-korea.standing: Daily reads of the Wikipedia article on South Korea, a democracy of about 51 million on the southern half of the Korean peninsula whose chipmakers and armed border with North Korea pull it into global news.
wiki-south-korea.recent: Lee Jae Myung threatened Ukraine with unspecified measures in a dispute over North Korean POWs, and investigators traced a DMZ blast to 2 landmines from North Korean forces. Seoul then recalled its Kyiv envoy, a first since 2008, and North Korea fired missiles days after South Korea's hypersonic test.

stocks:TSLA.standing: Shares in Tesla, the US maker of electric cars and grid batteries, listed on Nasdaq. Its valuation rests more on bets about self-driving cars and robots than on the cars it sells today, so it moves on Elon Musk's promises.
stocks:TSLA.recent: Tesla's sales fell 2 percent in Q3 2026, an underwhelming quarter, and Musk's plans in India stalled for both Tesla and Starlink. Neither accounts for the share price.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind the Claude models, is valued at $3 trillion or more before year end. Traders price it on fundraising rounds and the race for AI compute.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-texas-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Republican candidate wins Texas's US Senate race in November 2026. Texas has not elected a Democrat to the Senate since 1988, so the price is what traders will stake on that streak holding.

poly-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine hold direct peace talks before the end of November 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the two sides sitting down to negotiate an end to the war.
poly-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-by-novem.recent: Washington's Miami talks brought Ukraine and Europe together but left Russia out, and Zelenskyy said Russia ignored Kyiv's two-day pause on refinery strikes. The Trump–Zelensky rift widened too: Trump said Ukraine should elect a new president, and the US threatened to halt the Europe-funded arms pipeline.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Apple's shares, traded on the Nasdaq. Most of its revenue comes from the iPhone, and its weight as one of the world's most valuable companies means its moves carry the S&P 500 and Nasdaq indices with it.
stocks:AAPL.recent: Apple launched HomeView, a $299 tablet for the home, and tightened Mac full disk access for AI agents after complaints over Meta's Muse. OpenAI has since claimed that 100-plus secret files followed an ex-employee back to Apple. Tim Cook confirmed an Apple Intelligence beta in China this month, running on Alibaba's Qwen models after Beijing's regulators approved it.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: The first cryptocurrency, a fixed-supply digital currency run on a public ledger with no central issuer, launched in 2009. Its price sets the tone for the whole crypto market, and funds, banks and listed companies now hold it.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: The 2 October spike came as the US approved its first 3x leveraged crypto funds and Tether's $190 billion USDT stablecoin was coming back to the Bitcoin network. MSCI has since finalised rules that can eject Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes; JPMorgan puts the forced selling of Strategy shares at $2.8 billion.

stocks:MSTR.standing: A Nasdaq-listed software company that became the largest corporate holder of bitcoin, funding its purchases by selling new shares and debt. Its stock trades as a leveraged bet on the bitcoin price.
stocks:MSTR.recent: MSCI finalised rules that can eject companies whose main business is holding bitcoin from its equity indexes, putting Strategy and Japan's Metaplanet on notice. JPMorgan estimates $2.8 billion of forced selling of Strategy shares. The funds sell the stock, not the bitcoin, which squeezes the cheap equity the firm raises to buy more.

stocks:JPM.standing: America's largest bank by assets, spanning Chase consumer branches, a leading investment bank and a vast trading operation. Its quarterly results open US bank earnings season and are read as a check on the economy's health.
stocks:JPM.recent: Fed officials questioned JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Barclays and Morgan Stanley in a review of bank lending to private credit, prompted by worries over that market. When results arrived, a $1.2B money laundering penalty drove Bank of America to an earnings miss while JPMorgan Chase held steady.

stocks:3350.T.standing: A Tokyo-listed company that turned from running budget hotels to holding bitcoin as its main asset, and sells new shares to buy more. Its stock works as a leveraged bet on bitcoin for investors in Japan.
stocks:3350.T.recent: MSCI finalised rules that can eject companies whose main business is holding bitcoin from its equity indexes, Metaplanet among them. Index funds then sell the shares, not the bitcoin, which cuts at the cheap equity the firm raises to buy more; JPMorgan put the forced selling of Strategy alone at $2.8 billion.

stocks:MSCI.standing: The New York company whose stock indexes, among them MSCI World and MSCI Emerging Markets, decide what trillions of dollars in tracking funds must own. It also sells ESG ratings and risk analytics, and its fees grow with the assets benchmarked to it.
stocks:MSCI.recent: MSCI finalised rules that can eject bitcoin treasury firms such as Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes, with JPMorgan estimating $2.8 billion of forced selling of Strategy shares, and moved to strip Indonesia of emerging-market status, sending Jakarta to a six-year low. Neither decision accounts for the rise in its own share price.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republic.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if JD Vance, the US vice president, wins the 2028 Republican presidential nomination. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome in a race Donald Trump is barred from entering.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-june-30-2.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran's top leadership changes hands before the end of June 2027. It is where traders bet on how durable the Islamic Republic's rule is under war, sanctions and an unsettled succession.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-june-30-2.recent: Iran spent the fortnight striking shipping off Hormuz, sinking two Emirati cargo ships, and Britain blamed Iran's Guards for the RAF Fairford plot. US planners drafted strikes with a 21,600-pound bomb. None of it was a move against who governs in Tehran, and none of it accounts for the shift in the bets.

poly-will-raphal-glucksmann-win-the-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Raphaël Glucksmann, the centre-left MEP who leads Place Publique, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

stocks:HSBA.L.standing: One of Europe's largest banks, headquartered in London but earning most of its profit in Asia, above all in Hong Kong. Its London shares move on Asian interest rates and on the state of relations between China and the West.

stocks:TSM.standing: Shares of the world's largest contract chipmaker, which fabricates the most advanced processors for Apple, Nvidia and others from plants in Taiwan. Its order book is a direct read on demand for AI and smartphone chips.

poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Federal Reserve leaves its benchmark interest rate unchanged after its December 2026 meeting. That rate sets US borrowing costs and pulls the dollar and credit worldwide with it.
poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.recent: Bets moved toward a change as most Federal Reserve officials said they expected another rate hike by year-end, with US inflation above the Fed's target for 5.5 years. A September count of 29,000 jobs against 90,000 expected had the Fed seen skipping October, and Warsh, speaking in Bangkok, withheld guidance on what comes next.

stocks:INTC.standing: An American chipmaker that both designs and manufactures its own processors, which run most PCs and many servers. Its foundry arm, making chips for other firms, carries Washington's push for US-made semiconductors.
